question: What is the length of the side-line in field hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __91.4 m.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• The place on which field hockey is challenged is 91.4 m long and 55m wide. 
 
• This border is marked on the turf and the shorter lines are known as back
